scope: Seventy-five sequential Worker-owned clone ticks in a frozen mangrove-islands QA scene, one in flight, with direct diagnostic damage to the center before tick five. Position, heading, elapsed time, structure status, HP and collapseRemaining plus events are copied, but other simulation state and native world are not synchronized. All events are classified structural and there is no real visual hide, physics, input, rollback, continuous collision, interpolation, complete GPU accounting or production authority. Final Worker snapshot and ordered emitted events are compared with an independent reference.
